extraction.name: Geometry3K
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark consisting of 3,002 SAT-style geometry problems with dense annotations in formal language.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Ran Gong, Shibiao Jiang, Liang Qiu, Siyuan Huang, Xiaodan Liang, Song-Chun Zhu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Groups of well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collected each problem, including its text, diagram, choices, and correct answer, and labeled them with problem goals and geometry shapes.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Geometry problems from two popular high school textbooks (grades 6-12) available through online digital libraries.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators manually collected problems including text, diagrams, choices, and correct answers, and further labeled each problem with its corresponding goal and geometry shapes.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, and testing for geometry problem solvers and parsers.
